title: From Type to Token: Petri Nets, Individual Token Philosophy, and Individualized Causal Effects
abstract: arXiv:2611.05703v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Structural Causal Models and Bayesian Networks are the dominant framework for representing causal relations. They are fundamentally type-level formalisms since their estimands, Average Treatment Effects and Conditional Average Treatment Effects, are properties of distributions over populations, not of individual units. When treatment effects exhibit unbounded heterogeneity, these estimands collapse. What persists is the structural, token-level core of causation.   We argue that Petri Nets under the Individual Token Philosophy are the natural representation of these token-level causal structures. We develop a formal translation from Bayesian Networks to Petri Nets, providing a two-layer account of individualized causality. The PN layer provides a structural representation of causal mechanisms that does not rest on distributional assumptions. In turn, a conformal prediction layer quantifies causal effects with finite-sample coverage guaran

translated_title: 从类型到殊型：佩特里网、个体殊型哲学与个体化因果效应
translated_abstract: 结构因果模型和贝叶斯网络是表示因果关系的主流框架。它们本质上是类型层面的形式化方法，因为其估计量——平均处理效应（ATE）和条件平均处理效应（CATE）——是总体分布的性质，而非个体单元的性质。当处理效应表现出无界异质性时，这些估计量便会失效。此时仍然存在的是因果关系的结构性的、殊型层面的核心。我们论证，在个体殊型哲学下的佩特里网是这类殊型层面因果结构的自然表示。我们开发了从贝叶斯网络到佩特里网的形式化转换，为个体化因果性提供了一个两层解释：佩特里网层提供了不依赖分布假设的因果机制的结构表示，而保形预测层则在有限样本覆盖保证下量化因果效应。
tldr: 该论文提出以个体殊型哲学下的佩特里网作为殊型层面因果结构的自然表示，通过从贝叶斯网络到佩特里网的形式化转换并结合保形预测层，在不依赖分布假设且对处理效应异质性鲁棒的情况下实现个体化因果效应的量化。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Petri Nets under the Individual Token Philosophy as the natural representation of token-level causal structures, developing a formal translation from Bayesian Networks combined with a conformal prediction layer to quantify individualized causal effects without distributional assumptions and robust to unbounded treatment-effect heterogeneity.
